skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this script into a 30-second video with visuals and background music...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of text-to-video-capcut: instantly convert text scripts into ready-to-share videos using AI.
- Upload TXT, DOCX, PDF, or SRT files (up to 200MB) and get MP4 videos with visuals and background music in 1–2 minutes.
- Seamless onboarding with automatic token and session handling—no manual setup required.
- Supports key actions: upload, script conversion, preview, export, and credits check.
- Designed for TikTok creators and anyone looking to skip manual filming or editing.
